text:
This fearful, sad water,
like a suffering child,
faints before it even
touches the earth.


The tree is still, the wind still,
and in the awesome silence,
this fine, bitter weeping
falls!


The sky is like an immense
heart opening, bitterly.
It is not rain: it is a slow,
long bleeding.


Inside the home, people
do not feel this bitterness,
this sending of sad water
from above.


This long, exhausting
descending of defeated waters
toward the Earth, lying down
and stricken.


It rains… and like a tragic jackal
night waits in the mountains.
What will rise in the shadows
from the Earth?


Will you sleep while outside
this lifeless water falls, suffering,
this lethal water, sister
to Death?

translation.title: This Fearful, Sad Water...
